note: HAND-AUTHORED read/write sets, line-by-line from the verbatim C. Per-frame decrement of the projectile/tracker 'remaining distance' field: fVar2 = [a+0x184] - [a+0x44] (distance minus this frame's speed); stores it back to a+0x184 and stores fVar2/FLOAT_8043875c into a+0x60 (frames-to-arrival estimate). When that quotient falls to <= FLOAT_80438744 it tail-calls the external zz_00c42a8_(a) (expiry handler) -- a ROM callee the replay cannot model, so any case that takes it is CALLEE-TAINTED: the console's post-state at a+0x184 / a+0x60 may then include the callee's own stores. The spec detects the branch from the captured reads and reports those cases separately instead of pretending they are unit behaviour.
